dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Today let's talk about human rights. Which right is the most important to you, Nam?
dialogue.reading: təˈdeɪ ˈlɛts ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ˈhjuːmən ˈraɪts. ˈwɪtʃ ˈraɪt ɪz ðə ˈmoʊst ɪmˈpɔːrtənt tə juː, ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Freedom of speech. People should be able to say what they think, even if others disagree.
dialogue.reading: ˈfriːdəm əv ˈspiːtʃ. ˈpiːpəl ʃʊd bi ˈeɪbəl tə ˈseɪ ˈwʌt ðeɪ ˈθɪŋk, ˈiːvən ɪf ˈʌðərz ˌdɪsəˈɡriː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Even if what they say is offensive?
dialogue.reading: ˈiːvən ɪf ˈwʌt ðeɪ ˈseɪ ɪz əˈfɛnsɪv?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's difficult. If someone is just rude, that's OK. But discrimination is different.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈdɪfɪkəlt. ɪf ˈsʌmwʌn ɪz ˈdʒʌst ˈruːd, ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. bʌt dɪˌskrɪmɪˈneɪʃən ɪz ˈdɪfərənt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: If a company refuses to give someone a job because of where they're from, that's discrimination.
dialogue.reading: ɪf ə ˈkʌmpəni rɪˈfjuːzɪz tə ˈɡɪv ˈsʌmwʌn ə ˈdʒɑːb bɪˈkɔːz əv wɛr ðɛr ˈfrʌm, ðæts dɪˌskrɪmɪˈneɪʃən.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So freedom of speech has limits?
dialogue.reading: soʊ ˈfriːdəm əv ˈspiːtʃ ˈhæz ˈlɪmɪts?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Equality is a human right, too. Even if you don't like someone, you have to respect their rights.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. iˈkwɑːləti ɪz ə ˈhjuːmən ˈraɪt, ˈtuː. ˈiːvən ɪf juː ˈdoʊnt ˈlaɪk ˈsʌmwʌn, juː ˈhæf tə rɪˈspɛkt ðɛr ˈraɪts.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And if someone bullies you online, what can you do?
dialogue.reading: ənd ɪf ˈsʌmwʌn ˈbʊliz juː ˌɑːnˈlaɪn, ˈwʌt kən juː ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: If it's serious, you can go to the police. Everyone has the right to justice.
dialogue.reading: ɪf ɪts ˈsɪriəs, juː kən ˈɡoʊ tə ðə pəˈliːs. ˈɛvriwʌn ˈhæz ðə ˈraɪt tə ˈdʒʌstɪs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Even if the bully is anonymous?
dialogue.reading: ˈiːvən ɪf ðə ˈbʊli ɪz əˈnɑːnəməs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, even if they're anonymous. The police can often find them.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈiːvən ɪf ðɛr əˈnɑːnəməs. ðə pəˈliːs kən ˈɔːfən ˈfaɪnd ðɛm.
